<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the peaks in the aromatic region (≈110–160 ppm) are at 151.28, 134.64, 132.51, 124.01, 123.09, and 122.26 ppm, totaling six signals. Each signal corresponds to an aromatic carbon, so the molecule contains six aromatic carbons.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
